forbidden.comment: Orphan files (not imported anywhere) are usually dead code.
forbidden.name: no-orphans

forbidden.comment: Use the @/ alias, not ../ parent imports.
forbidden.name: no-parent-imports

forbidden.comment: Domain must be framework-agnostic (no NestJS, Drizzle, AWS, class-validator, pg, etc.).
forbidden.name: domain-must-be-pure

forbidden.comment: Domain cannot depend on application, infrastructure or presentation.
forbidden.name: domain-no-upper-layers

forbidden.comment: Application can only depend on domain (ports + primitives). No infrastructure, no presentation.
forbidden.name: application-no-infra-or-presentation

forbidden.comment: Application must not import drizzle-orm — use repository ports instead.
forbidden.name: application-no-drizzle

forbidden.comment: Infrastructure implements domain ports. It must not depend on application or presentation.
forbidden.name: infrastructure-no-app-or-presentation

forbidden.comment: Presentation must not depend on infrastructure. Wiring lives in src/composition-root/.
forbidden.name: presentation-no-infrastructure

forbidden.comment: Layers must not depend on the composition root. The composition root is the only place that wires modules; it depends on layers, not the reverse.
forbidden.name: layers-no-composition-root

forbidden.comment: A bounded context in src/modules/ must not import another bounded context.
forbidden.name: cross-context-forbidden

forbidden.comment: Files under src/modules/<context>/ must live under domain/, application/, infrastructure/ or presentation/.
forbidden.name: modules-must-live-in-layers
